description: This Swift source file defines data structures and utility methods for managing and displaying usage data related to gateways, including models for usage windows, providers, summaries, and UI display logic such as formatting text and calculating remaining usage percentages.

classes.name: GatewayUsageWindow
classes.description: Represents a usage window with label, percentage used, and reset time.

classes.name: GatewayUsageProvider
classes.description: Represents a gateway provider with display details, associated windows, and optional plan or error message.

classes.name: GatewayUsageSummary
classes.description: Encapsulates the overall usage summary with timestamp and list of providers.

classes.name: UsageRow
classes.description: A view model for displaying usage information, including calculated fields like remainingPercent and formatted detail text.

methods.name: primaryRows
methods.description: Generates a list of primary usage rows based on provider windows, selecting the window with the maximum usedPercent.

methods.name: detailText
methods.description: Returns a detailed string about remaining usage, reset time, and window label.

methods.name: formatResetRemaining
methods.description: Formats the remaining time until reset into a human-readable string.
